dataset.title: Inflammatory microenvironment in immunometabolic-compromised treated HIV infection steered synaptic dysregulation

findings.message: 109 row(s) of PeptideQuantification.tsv carry no multiplex label, with 1392 value(s), stored as written. A peptide with no label gives no reporter ions of its own, so these values are co-isolated interference (QuantProject 066, rule 4); a protein group's value can include them. Leave them out of peptide-level statistics. MetaMorpheus is to stop quantifying them (QuantProject 068, ruling 1). E.g. `[Common Biological:Acetylation on X]AAAAASGAGGAAGAGTGGAGPAGR`, `[Common Biological:Acetylation on X]AAAAVGAGHGAGGPGAASSSGGAR`, `[Common Biological:Acetylation on X]AENTEGDLNSNLLHAPYHTGDPQLDTAIGQWLR` and 106 more.
The search identified an unusually small fraction of the MS2 spectra. Treat absence of a protein in this dataset as weak evidence. Producer's note: 154/179780 = 0.09% of MS2 identified (S3)

no SDRF says which sample is in which channel (no curated design and no deposited SDRF); PXReprise's default design makes each file its own plex and each channel its own sample; the reporter values compare nothing until a design is curated (QuantProject 079)

No SDRF was found for this dataset, so each channel's sample is the sample its search's TmtDesign.txt names (its `Sample Name`), with nothing else known about it. There is no sample metadata: treat every sample as unannotated.

12 of the 12 files were searched as acquired, not calibrated (their names in the search carry no `-calib`): `20230525_HF2_01_BrainOrganoids_TMT_Frac1`, `20230525_HF2_01_BrainOrganoids_TMT_Frac10`, `20230525_HF2_01_BrainOrganoids_TMT_Frac11`, `20230525_HF2_01_BrainOrganoids_TMT_Frac12`, `20230525_HF2_01_BrainOrganoids_TMT_Frac2`, `20230525_HF2_01_BrainOrganoids_TMT_Frac3`, `20230525_HF2_01_BrainOrganoids_TMT_Frac4`, `20230525_HF2_01_BrainOrganoids_TMT_Frac5`, `20230525_HF2_01_BrainOrganoids_TMT_Frac6`, `20230525_HF2_01_BrainOrganoids_TMT_Frac7` and 2 more. Their reporter values are the same kind of number; their identifications rest on uncalibrated precursor masses (QuantProject 066, rule 3).

PTM site occupancy was not stored: this is a TMT dataset, and MetaMorpheus computes intensity occupancy for label-free searches only; its count occupancy is per file, repeated on every channel (QuantProject DEF-OCC-INT). `ptm_stoichiometry` has no rows here because of that, not because no site was modified.

dataset.summary: PXD043296 is a DDA isobaric dataset (Homo sapiens) with 12 runs, 132 samples and no enrichment step (whole proteome). It was reanalysed with MetaMorpheus 1.1.13. At 1% FDR the search reports 154 PSMs, 114 peptidoforms and 109 protein groups, and the repository holds 229 PTM sites for it. 6 open warnings about it are recorded.

organisms_are: `organisms` is the organism of the protein DATABASE the search used, not a statement about the samples. Sample annotation, where any exists, is in the catalog's `samples` and `sample_characteristics` tables.
